result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for crossing. However, pedestrians must traverse four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, and the wide roadway geometry likely encourages higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide lane widths
hazards.description: The wide, straight roadway design may encourage vehicle speeds that are unsafe for a residential pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and curb ramps with tactile warning pads, providing a solid foundation for pedestrian safety. However, the environment is compromised by parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines near the crossing and a lack of clearly visible pedestrian signal heads.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb near the crosswalk obscure the visibility between pedestrians and approaching drivers, particularly for shorter individuals or children.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb on the right side of the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Visible Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While the intersection is signalized for vehicles, no pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, which can lead to uncertainty during crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear guidance on the remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and overhead traffic signals, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide four-lane roadway lacks a median refuge, and parked vehicles near the crossing may create sightline obstructions for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic across four lanes without a median refuge or pedestrian signal visible.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines at the crosswalk.
